name: The System Design Primer
summary: Open-source guide with system design topics, interview questions with solutions and Anki flashcard decks.
description: A continually updated, open-source guide to designing large-scale systems, written for engineers prepping for system design interviews. It indexes system design topics with pros and cons — scalability, CAP, consistency and availability patterns, DNS, CDNs, load balancing, databases, caching, asynchronism and communication — then pairs a study guide for short, medium and long timelines with interview questions, sample solutions and Anki flashcard decks.
contains: open-source guide to designing large-scale systems
index of system design topics with pros and cons
8 system design interview questions with sample solutions
Anki flashcard decks for spaced repetition
study guide for short, medium and long interview timelines
how to approach a system design interview question in 4 steps
